name: token-usage
description: A band above the prompt with context fill, the 5-hour and weekly windows, reset countdowns, a burn-rate forecast and cost. /tokens opens a detail pane; /tokens style, or words such as /tokens bars, change the layout, colours and labels.

style.title: Desktop band layout
style.description: The layout the desktop app starts with: rings, bars, compact, frames or stack. A layout chosen with /tokens is kept and wins over this until /tokens reset.

colorOk.title: Colour below 60%
colorOk.description: Hex colour of a desktop ring or bar under 60% used, such as #3a9a53. Anything that is not a hex colour falls back to the default.

colorWarn.title: Colour from 60%
colorWarn.description: Hex colour of a desktop ring or bar from 60% used, such as #b07f00.

colorFull.title: Colour from 85%
colorFull.description: Hex colour of a desktop ring or bar from 85% used, such as #e04f63.
